name: FullPiP — Picture-in-Picture
author: krittaphato3
description: Smart multi-window PiP with mode selection. Right-click any video or press Alt+P.
_note_host_permissions: activeTab only grants the tab the user invoked the extension on; popup windows opened via chrome.windows.create are new tabs where activeTab does not apply, so scripting.executeScript CSS injection into those popup tabs requires host_permissions.

toggle-pip.description: Toggle PiP for the main media on page

toggle-picker.description: Toggle picker mode to select any element for PiP
